company.name: Soul Artists
company.shortDescription: Soul Artists is a Dubai-based entertainment technology and talent-booking platform.
company.description: Soul Artists is a Dubai-based entertainment technology and talent-booking platform that connects performing artists, musicians, DJs, dancers, magicians, and entertainers with clients and event organizers worldwide. The company operates as a digital marketplace for live entertainment, helping users discover, book, and manage artists for corporate events, weddings, festivals, private parties, and other live experiences.

productsAndServices.description: A digital marketplace connecting event organizers with performing artists and musicians for live entertainment bookings.
productsAndServices.name: Live Entertainment Booking Platform

productsAndServices.description: A service allowing performers to apply to join the platform, with manual review to ensure quality and professionalism.

productsAndServices.description: A tool that allows event organizers to submit event details and receive real-time applications and quotes from relevant artists.
productsAndServices.name: Instant Quote Request Feature

productsAndServices.description: A payment system that holds funds securely and offers a money-back guarantee if the artist cancels or fails to perform.
productsAndServices.name: Secure Payment and Escrow Service

productsAndServices.description: A communication feature that allows clients and artists to discuss event details and negotiate booking terms before confirmation.
productsAndServices.name: Direct Messaging and Negotiation Tool

productsAndServices.description: A system that allows clients to rate and review artists after events to provide feedback and maintain platform standards.
productsAndServices.name: Artist Review and Rating System

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Convertible note round raised $350,000, or 60.34% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $353,866 to $600,003, a 1.7x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
